name: content
description: The content section of the hero. Alternatively supports an array of `content` objects.

params.name: heading
params.description: Optional heading for content column.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the heading.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the heading.

params.name: href
params.description: If set, the heading will become a link.

params.name: caption
params.description: Optional caption for the heading.

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the heading – `"m"`, `"l"` or `"xl"`. Defaults to `"xl"`.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional heading level. Defaults to `1`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

params.name: text
params.description: Optional text to use within each content column. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: Optional HTML to use within each content column. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: image
params.description: Optional image to use within each content column.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of each content column. You can pass any design system grid width here – for example, `"one-third"`, `"two-thirds"` or `"one-half"`. Defaults to `"one-half"`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the content column.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the heading.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the heading.

params.name: href
params.description: If set, the heading will become a link.

params.name: caption
params.description: Optional caption for the heading.

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the heading – `"m"`, `"l"` or `"xl"`. Defaults to `"xl"`.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional heading level. Defaults to `1`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

name: text
description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the hero. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the hero. If `text` is provided, the `html` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly a parameter but a Nunjucks code convention. Using a `call` block enables you to call a macro with all the text inside the tag. This is helpful if you want to pass a lot of content into a macro. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire hero component in a `call` block.

name: image
description: Can be used to add an image to the hero component.

params.name: src
params.description: The URL of the image in the hero.

name: width
description: Width of the hero content. You can pass any design system grid width here – for example, `"one-third"`, `"two-thirds"` or `"one-half"`. Defaults to `"one-half"`.

name: containerClasses
description: Classes to add to the hero container, useful if you want to make the hero fixed width.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the hero.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the hero.

name: border
description: If set to `false`, remove border from the hero.
